tweet.text: While we built MALT to test the monitoring systems we and others use, we’re excited for researchers to explore other use-cases for this dataset, especially the 103 natural examples of reward hacking behavior. Please reach out to neev@metr.org (and cc info@metr.org) if you have any questions or if you think you would benefit from the private split!
